nodes.name: Enroll New Lead (called from WF5)
nodes.notes: This node is called from WF5 when a new lead is qualified. It creates the 5 follow-up schedule rows in Supabase.

meta.description: Hourly cron checks for pending follow-ups. Sends personalised Day 0/1/3/5/7 emails. Also exposes enrollment entry point called by WF5 for new leads.

_setupNotes.SEQUENCE: Days: 0 (Welcome, 30min), 1 (Service Info, +1 day), 3 (Case Study, +3 days), 5 (Consultation Reminder, +5 days), 7 (Special Offer, +7 days)
_setupNotes.SMTP_CREDENTIAL_ID: Set up SMTP credential in n8n. Recommend SendGrid for tracking open/click rates.
_setupNotes.CALENDLY_BOOKING_URL: Update all CTA URLs with your actual Calendly booking link
_setupNotes.UNSUBSCRIBE: Add proper unsubscribe handling before production launch to comply with CAN-SPAM / GDPR
